title: Login page error
description: Users cannot log in with correct credentials, causing frustration and preventing access to essential account features.

title: Payment gateway timeout
description: Payment processing intermittently fails during checkout, delaying purchases and leading to customer dissatisfaction and potential revenue loss.

title: UI glitch on dashboard
description: Graphs and widgets overlap or disappear when resizing the dashboard, making monitoring and analysis tasks difficult for users.

title: Email notifications not sent
description: Automated email notifications fail to reach users, causing missed alerts and delays in responding to critical system updates.

title: Profile picture upload fails
description: Uploading profile pictures larger than two megabytes fails, frustrating users who wish to personalize their account profiles properly.

title: Slow search functionality
description: Search requests take longer than ten seconds to return results, reducing efficiency and making the application less user-friendly overall.

title: Broken links on FAQ page
description: Several links on the FAQ page lead to error pages, leaving users unable to find answers to common questions effectively.

title: Data export not working
description: Exporting large datasets to CSV format fails consistently, preventing users from analyzing data externally and completing their tasks efficiently.

title: Incorrect total in reports
description: Monthly reports display inaccurate totals for sales data, causing confusion and affecting decision-making processes for management and stakeholders.

title: Mobile layout broken
description: The mobile layout appears distorted on small screens, causing navigation difficulties and reducing overall usability for smartphone users.

title: Session timeout too short
description: Users are logged out after only five minutes of inactivity, interrupting workflows and forcing repeated logins unnecessarily.

title: Error 500 on checkout
description: During the checkout process, the server returns an error 500, preventing users from completing purchases and causing order failures.
